accommodation.name: Onefam Waterloo
accommodation.cancellationPolicy: Non-refundable rate. 2 full day cancellation policy would otherwise apply (last free cancellation day is 2 days before check-in).
accommodation.facilities: Shared, mixed, communal dorms with triple bunk beds. Historic building with stairs (no elevators). Maximum stay 7 nights per guest.
accommodation.notes: Onefam Waterloo (73 Lambeth Walk, SE11 6DX). Standard 12 Bed Mixed Dorm, 3 nights. Total: £87.94 (Paid online: €20.63, Balance at property: £71.23, taxes included in price). Near Waterloo Station in central London.

arrival.notes: Eurostar direct train from Paris Gare du Nord (Coach 4 - Seat 93). Departs 07:32, arrives 09:00 (2h 28m). From St Pancras to Onefam Waterloo: Northern Line southbound to Kennington/Waterloo, or Piccadilly/Jubilee Line combination via Green Park/Westminster.

departure.notes: ✅ CONFIRMED - FlixBus Route N814 (direction Amsterdam Sloterdijk), operated by FlixBus B.V. Departs London Victoria Coach Station (164 Buckingham Palace Road, SW1W9TP) at 19:30 on Sat Oct 24, arrives Bruges Station (Rijselstraat-Spoorwegstraat, 8200 Brugge) at 03:00 on Sun Oct 25. Seat 14D. days.title: City of London: St Paul's, Monument, Tower Bridge & Tower of London

timeBlocks.name: morning
timeBlocks.description: St Paul's Cathedral and the Monument to the Great Fire of London.

activities.name: St Paul's Cathedral ⭐
activities.timeRestriction: Closed to tourists on Sundays (services only)
activities.notes: Iconic dome designed by Christopher Wren. Climb to the Whispering Gallery and Golden Gallery for sweeping city views.

activities.name: Monument to the Great Fire of London (Exterior Only)
activities.notes: Wren-designed column commemorating the Great Fire of 1666. Viewing from outside only - skipping the paid 311-step climb to the top.

activities.name: Borough Market ⭐ 🍽️
activities.notes: One of London's oldest and most famous food markets - amazing street food stalls, artisan cheese, and baked goods near London Bridge.

timeBlocks.name: afternoon
timeBlocks.description: Tower Bridge, St Dunstan in the East Church Garden, and the Tower of London.

activities.name: Tower Bridge ⭐
activities.notes: Iconic Victorian bascule bridge over the Thames. Free to cross and photograph; optional paid Tower Bridge Exhibition with glass floor walkway.

activities.name: St Dunstan in the East Church Garden
activities.notes: Hidden gem - a peaceful public garden built within the ruins of a WWII-bombed church, covered in climbing ivy and greenery.

activities.name: Tower of London (Exterior Sights Only)
activities.notes: Historic castle and former prison on the Thames. Viewing the walls, moat, and Traitors' Gate from outside only - skipping the paid interior (Crown Jewels, Beefeater tour).

research_notes.notes: Day 2 is the City of London day: St Paul's Cathedral, the Monument (exterior only), Borough Market for lunch, Tower Bridge, St Dunstan in the East Church Garden, and the Tower of London (exterior/sights only, no paid entry).

days.title: Westminster: Big Ben, London Eye, Parks, Buckingham Palace & Free Abbey Evensong

timeBlocks.name: morning
timeBlocks.description: Big Ben, St James's Park, and Buckingham Palace.

activities.name: Big Ben (Elizabeth Tower) ⭐
activities.notes: Iconic clock tower at the Houses of Parliament. Exterior view/photo stop (interior tours require separate advance booking).

activities.name: St James's Park ⭐
activities.notes: Elegant royal park with a scenic lake, pelicans, and classic views of Buckingham Palace and Westminster.

activities.name: Buckingham Palace ⭐
activities.timeRestriction: Changing of the Guard schedule varies - check official site
activities.notes: Official residence of the British monarch. Exterior/gates view (palace interior tours only open seasonally and require separate booking). Check if Changing of the Guard is scheduled.

timeBlocks.name: lunch
timeBlocks.description: Lunch near Westminster/South Bank, then the London Eye (sights only).

activities.name: Lunch near South Bank
activities.notes: Quick lunch along the South Bank before the London Eye.

activities.name: London Eye (Sights Only, No Ride)
activities.notes: Giant Ferris wheel on the South Bank - viewed and photographed from the ground along the Thames path. Skipping the paid ride up.

timeBlocks.name: afternoon
timeBlocks.description: Hyde Park, before heading back to Westminster Abbey for Evensong.

activities.name: Hyde Park ⭐
activities.notes: One of London's largest Royal Parks - Serpentine Lake, Speakers' Corner, and wide open green space for a relaxed afternoon stroll.

timeBlocks.name: evening
timeBlocks.description: Free entry into Westminster Abbey by attending Evensong.

activities.name: Westminster Abbey - Free Entry via Evensong ⭐
activities.timeRestriction: Evensong is typically held on weekdays around 17:00 (Fridays sometimes spoken, not sung) - CONFIRM the exact day's schedule on the official site before relying on this, as times/days shift seasonally and for special events.
activities.notes: Research finding: Westminster Abbey offers FREE entry to anyone attending a church service, including the daily sung Evensong (choir service), instead of paying the ~£27-30 sightseeing ticket. Arrive 15-20 min early and queue at the correct door (ask staff/check site for current entrance - typically the North Door). You won't get the full self-guided tour access (roped-off areas during worship), but you do get to sit inside the historic Quire and Sanctuary and hear the famous choir - arguably a more atmospheric experience than the daytime tour queue. ⚠️ Verify the exact schedule close to the travel date, as service days/times can change.

bookingDetails.advanceTimeNeeded: No booking needed - just arrive early (15-20 min) and check that day's service schedule online first

activities.opening_hours: Check official 'Daily Services' page for exact times
activities.cost: free (service attendance only, not a full sightseeing tour)

sources.name: Westminster Abbey official site - Daily Services page
sources.type: official site (general knowledge, not independently re-verified for Oct 2026 dates)

research_notes.notes: Day 3 reordered so Westminster Abbey is visited for FREE by attending Evensong in the early evening (~17:00) instead of paying for the daytime sightseeing ticket (~£27-30). Big Ben, St James's Park, and Buckingham Palace moved to the morning; London Eye is now sights-only (no ride); Hyde Park fills the afternoon before heading back for the service. ⚠️ Evensong schedule should be double-checked on the official site closer to the trip, since exact days/times vary and are occasionally cancelled for special events.

must_try_dishes.description: Battered and deep-fried white fish (cod or haddock) with thick-cut chips. The classic British takeaway, best from a proper chippy rather than a tourist-trap pub.
Roasted meat (beef, chicken, or lamb) with Yorkshire pudding, roast potatoes, vegetables, and gravy. Classic pub tradition, typically only served on Sundays.
Eggs, bacon, sausage, baked beans, grilled tomato, mushrooms, and toast. A hearty way to start the day, found at cafes ('greasy spoons') everywhere.
London's beloved curry-house staple - grilled chicken in a creamy spiced tomato sauce. A product of British-Indian fusion, found at curry houses across the city (Brick Lane is famous for this).
Everything from raclette and salt beef sandwiches to fresh oysters and artisan baked goods - the best way to sample a wide range of food in one place.
Finger sandwiches, scones with clotted cream and jam, and pastries, served with a pot of tea. A quintessentially British experience, though pricier at famous hotels.

drinks_and_rituals.description: Classic British ale, lager, or cider at a traditional pub - as much a social ritual as a drink.
Strong black tea with milk, the everyday staple drink found everywhere from cafes to hostels.

special_meal_formats: Pub lunch/dinner deals - many pubs offer set menus or '2 meals for X GBP' deals on weekdays
Supermarket meal deals (Tesco, Sainsbury's, Boots) - sandwich + snack + drink combo, usually 3.5-5 GBP, a cheap and quick lunch option
tourist_traps_to_avoid: Restaurants directly on/around Leicester Square and Covent Garden - inflated prices for mediocre food aimed at tourists
Pre-packaged 'Fish and Chips' at major tourist landmarks (e.g., right next to the London Eye or Tower Bridge) - better quality and value a few streets away

average_food_budget_reference.note: Rough daily food budget guide for London (per person), covering the ~3-4 full days on the ground
average_food_budget_reference.breakfast: 3-10 GBP (pastry/coffee on the go to a sit-down Full English)
average_food_budget_reference.lunch: 8-15 GBP (sandwich/market stall to a casual sit-down)
average_food_budget_reference.snacks_and_drinks: 5-10 GBP (coffee, pub pint, or market snack)
average_food_budget_reference.daily_total_estimate: ~30-55 GBP/day on food if eating casually/mid-range, more if doing Afternoon Tea or sit-down dinners regularly
